title: hymenophyllum peltatum
intro: Hymenophyllum peltatum, commonly known as the fern-like Hymenophyllum, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Hymenophyllum peltatum include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms associated with respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
